_comment: The variant switchboard: every open design decision, its options and its default. Each layer reads only its own decisions (layer). applies: live (takes effect at once), next_fight, or next_run. built: false marks an option listed for the dev screen that no code implements yet; choosing it changes nothing. params are the option's tunable numbers. The player's choices are stored in user://variants.json as {"choices": {decision id: option id}}, holding non-default choices only. A decision with default_from takes its default and options from another data file instead (options_from). See data/variants/README.md. Every number in params is a first guess, not balance.

options.name: Banked charge toward the next action
options.description: While waiting, energy recharges faster by wait.recharge_bonus_percent (data/combat/combat_tuning.json).

options.name: Extra energy
options.description: Waiting recharges at the normal rate; starting a wait grants extra_energy_points at once.

options.name: Bonus damage on the next action
options.description: Waiting recharges at the normal rate; the damage skill that ends the wait deals bonus_damage_percent more.

options.name: Snap to the first affordable tick
options.description: A wait ends on the first tick the unit can afford the skill it waited for.

options.name: Choose an exact wait
options.description: A wait may name an exact number of ticks (1 to max_wait_ticks); it ends then, affordable or not. A wait naming none still snaps. Policies keep snapping; the battle screen shows a tick picker.

options.name: No effect
options.description: Elasticity is stored but does nothing.

options.name: Reduces big hits
options.description: The part of a hit above big_hit_percent of the defender's max hp is cut by elasticity x reduce_percent_per_point percent, at most max_reduce_percent.

options.name: Resists turn-order knockback
options.description: Every damaging hit knocks the target's gauge back by knockback_gauge, less elasticity x resist_gauge_per_point (never below 0).

options.name: Regains energy when hit
options.description: A unit that takes damage regains elasticity x energy_milli_per_point thousandths of energy, capped at its pool.

options.name: Current mapping
options.description: drift_rules in data/post_fight/post_fight.json.

options.name: Mapping by target choice
options.description: Only what a bot aims at moves it: drift_rule_sets.by_target in data/post_fight/post_fight.json.

options.name: Drift off
options.description: No decision moves a personality.

options.name: Full heal
options.description: Every bot heals to full after each fight.

options.name: Carry damage over
options.description: Bots keep the hp they ended the fight with; a downed bot comes back with downed_hp.

options.name: Partial heal
options.description: Bots keep their end hp plus heal_percent of max hp, capped at max; a downed bot starts from downed_hp.

options.name: Random
options.description: Every starting skill at random.

options.name: Damage guarantee
options.description: As random, but a bot with no damage skill swaps one in.

options.name: Non-strike damage
options.description: As damage_guarantee, but the basic attack does not count.

options.name: Tier from generation (current)
options.description: A bot's personality generation picks its tier: medium from medium_at, advanced from advanced_at. Read by the battle screen (ui/fight/battle_tier_rule.gd).

options.name: Tier from skill levels
options.description: The levels a bot has gained across its skills (each skill's level above 1, summed) pick its tier: medium from medium_at, advanced from advanced_at.

options.name: Tier from augments
options.description: The augments a bot has fitted pick its tier: medium from medium_at, advanced from advanced_at.
